verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no dedicated, officially documented Codex SDK. What exists is adjacent programmatic surfaces: an experimental JSON-RPC interface to control a local Codex engine via `codex mcp-server`, now deprecated in favor of the app server; `codex exec` for scripted and CI workflows; and OpenAI's platform API reference, which has runnable samples in Python, TypeScript, Go, Ruby and Java plus an OpenAPI 3.1 spec. That platform API is the OpenAI API rather than a Codex-specific library, so an AI-native builder must work through these substitutes. Missing for 10: a first-party Codex SDK package with docs, stable non-deprecated programmatic interface documentation, language coverage specific to Codex, and hands-on corroboration of building against it.
